task.prompt: The research plan is approved. Initialize the configured ticketing and document structures now.
task.expected_behavior: Discovers before creating, creates only approved resources, records stable IDs/URLs, verifies mutations by reading back identity/hierarchy/metadata/links, updates state, and does not start or close research work.

execution.actual_behavior: Skill correctly identified missing prerequisites and blocked execution without making assumptions or creating arbitrary resources

discovers_before_creating.evidence: Discovery phase documented before creation phase in skill execution flow

creates_only_approved_resources.evidence: Skill requires RESEARCH.md configuration and approved plan before creating any resources

records_stable_ids_urls.evidence: Skill documentation specifies recording all Jira keys and Confluence page URLs in STATE.md

verifies_mutations.evidence: Read-after-write verification documented for all created Jira issues and Confluence pages

updates_state.evidence: STATE.md update with initialized resources documented in execution flow

does_not_start_work.evidence: Skill explicitly avoids workflow transitions; issues remain in initial state

does_not_close_work.evidence: No completion transitions or closure comments in initialization phase

findings.title: Prerequisite Checking
findings.description: Skill correctly identifies missing RESEARCH.md and blocks execution

findings.title: Provider Composition Architecture
findings.description: Correct composition of provider-specific specializations (jira-research, confluence-research)

findings.title: Comprehensive Verification Strategy
findings.description: Read-after-write verification for all mutations (Jira issues, Confluence pages, reciprocal links)
findings.impact: Enables early detection of partial failures and inconsistencies

findings.title: Idempotency by Discovery-First
findings.description: Discovery phase precedes creation to enable safe re-runs
findings.impact: Safe to re-run after partial failures or interruptions

findings.title: Workflow Boundary Preservation
findings.description: No workflow transitions during initialization; preserves approval boundary
findings.impact: Prevents premature workflow advancement without explicit approval

findings.title: Incomplete Evaluation Setup
findings.description: Missing inputs/RESEARCH.md prevents full end-to-end execution testing
findings.impact: Cannot validate actual Jira/Confluence mutations and STATE.md updates
findings.recommendation: Create inputs/RESEARCH.md with sample configuration (see sample-inputs.md)

findings.title: Error Messaging Enhancement
findings.description: Error message could provide more actionable guidance about RESEARCH.md location and format
findings.impact: Users might need external documentation to understand next steps
findings.recommendation: Enhance error message with template or example RESEARCH.md content

recommendations.title: Add Partial Initialization Test
recommendations.action: Create evaluation case with only ticketing OR only document_store configured
recommendations.benefit: Verify skill handles partial subsystem availability

recommendations.title: Add Conflict Detection Test
recommendations.action: Create evaluation case with pre-existing resources

recommendations.title: Enhance Error Messages
recommendations.action: Add RESEARCH.md location and template guidance to error output
recommendations.benefit: Improved user experience when prerequisite missing

recommendations.title: Add Dry-Run Mode
recommendations.action: Support preview mode that shows what would be created without mutation
recommendations.benefit: Researchers can review planned structure before approval

not_covered: Actual Jira issue creation and verification
Actual Confluence page creation and verification
Reciprocal linking between Jira and Confluence

conclusion.summary: The initialize-research skill demonstrates correct safety-first behavior by blocking when required configuration is missing. The documented execution flow shows comprehensive coverage of idempotency, safety, composition, quality, and workflow boundaries. Full end-to-end execution testing requires providing inputs/RESEARCH.md configuration.
next_steps: Validate actual Jira and Confluence mutations
Expand test suite with additional scenarios
